scope: Static test/CI review and reading existing execution evidence only; no test or engine execution by reviewer.

protocols.checks: Native-C oracle, V8 and Wasmtime output for nested fixed/limited layouts, declared padding, zero/nonzero defaults, enum tag behavior, strings, empty capacity and signed values.
Side-effect counter proves once-only fill evaluation even at count0 and ordered field effects; optional reference asserts selected run bodies unchanged.
Four cases cover self-aliasing assignment, observing nested closure, reference/slice fields and effectful per-element defaults; native oracle and both engines, plus optional reference byte equality.
Empty default and128-element nonzero limited-array semantics; optional reference requires fewer memory.copy instructions and a smaller parsed activation reservation.
Zero-default/nonzero fixed arrays and a fixed record preserve semantics and, with reference compiler, exact selected run bodies.
Both engines repeat start/typed mutation three times; zero array checksum and record/string values reset correctly.
Both engines repeat dirty-global/start-trap three times; Abort callback reenters read export, checks state107, capacity message and line2. Optional baseline comparison checks complete observations.

matrix: Every protocol runs O0/O2 with debug off/on. First five use a native-C output oracle and both V8/Wasmtime; last two use custom dual-engine state/reentry harnesses.
harness_review: Current function bytes are captured before optional baseline compilation reuses temporary output paths. Compiler selection is restored in finally blocks.

Byte identity, memory.copy reduction and frame-size assertions require --reference-goose; semantic checks remain active without it. CI invokes the new test directly without a historical compiler, so CI alone does not enforce historical code-shape comparisons.

frame_size is a narrow parser for these small known prologue fixtures, not a general signed-LEB/prologue decoder. Padding is exercised by typed layout behavior; this suite does not compare every raw padding byte.
The seven tests are meaningful bounded fixtures, not exhaustive coverage of all layouts, prefix-map states or the512-node proof boundary. Broader existing qualification remains necessary.

existing_execution.development_note: The seven-test step passed; enclosing orchestration later failed starting its first gate run. It is not relabeled as an overall pass.
